newsitem.title: UK: Britain's Ofwat review might consider one-off cuts.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Ofwat review might consider one-off cuts.

text.p: British water industry regulator Ofwat head Ian Byatt could consider a one-off price cut as part of the next periodic review if companies had outperformed, an Ofwat spokeswoman confirmed.
"It is one of the areas that he could consider as part of the major consultations taking place," she said.
Byatt told a parliamentary select committee on Wednesday that such a move might be considered for the initial year of the next pricing period, which will be reviewed in 1999, the spokeswoman said.
She said such a move would be along the same lines as one-off cuts imposed by power regulators.
Electricity industry regulator Offer called for a one-off price cuts of 20 percent from April in its pricing proposals for National Grid, following inflation-related caps.
Byatt has consistently emphasised the need for water companies to share any efficiency savings between customers and shareholders.
